body.name: \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{pub}}\)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{pub}}\) consists of tuples \((P,B^0,\varepsilon,\pi_0)\) satisfying \(p\geq2\), \(m\geq2\), \(\texttt{ass:centered-gaussian-law}\), \(\texttt{ass:linear-structural-equations}\), and \(\texttt{ass:shared-topological-order}\), and additionally satisfying \(\operatorname{Var}_P(\varepsilon_j^{(a)})>0\) for every \(a\in M\) and \(j\in V\). No restriction is imposed on \(\operatorname{Cov}_P(\varepsilon_i^{(a)},\varepsilon_j^{(b)})\) when \(a\ne b\), whether or not \(i=j\). This is a deliberately weakened unrestricted-cross-view comparison class: it retains the cited paper's shared-order structural primitives but does not assert that its correlation-and-diversity identification qualifier holds.
